We are pleased to announce that ticket sales for **CAAD Futures 2025** are now open. 

Tickets can be purchased via [`the official registration portal`](https://hkuems1.hku.hk/hkuems/ec_hdetail.aspx?guest=Y&ueid=100350).

---

### Ticket Categories

<hr class="faint-line">

Three types of registration tickets are available:

- **Regular Ticket** – HKD 5,400  
- **Student Ticket** – HKD 2,700  
  _50% discounted, available exclusively to students currently enrolled in Bachelor’s or Master’s level programmes_  
- **Supported Ticket** – HKD 275  
  _Reserved for approved authors from low- and lower-middle-income countries (as defined by the World Bank)_

An optional printed hard copy of the **Companion Publication** can be purchased for an additional HKD 500. Copies will be distributed at the start of the conference.

A **10% Early Bird Discount** is available for all ticket categories until **25 May 2025**. Subject to availability, **late registration tickets** will be offered at a 10% surcharge starting **22 June 2025**.

---

### Publication Requirements

<hr class="faint-line">

To be eligible for inclusion in the official conference proceedings:

- Each **accepted paper or Catalytic Interface team** must have at least one presenting author registered and paid by **1 June 2025**
- The presenting author must attend in person in **Hong Kong** and present the work at the scheduled time
- Each accepted paper must be associated with a **unique, fully registered conference participant**

---

### Reduced Fee Tickets

<hr class="faint-line">

##### Student Tickets

Available only to individuals enrolled in **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree programmes** (PhD students are not eligible).  
To validate eligibility:

- Submit proof of enrolment (valid student ID + current registration status)
- Email to: [candylnt@hku.hk](mailto:candylnt@hku.hk) within 7 days of purchase  
Failure to comply may result in **cancellation of the ticket without refund**.

##### Supported Tickets

Subsidised tickets are available for:

- Authors from World Bank-classified low- or lower-middle-income countries
- Who have **successfully passed peer review** and require financial assistance

**Prior approval** must be obtained by contacting [candylnt@hku.hk](mailto:candylnt@hku.hk)  
Tickets purchased **without approval** may be deemed **invalid without refund**.

---

### Tours of Hong Kong

<hr class="faint-line">

A curated series of **cultural and social activities** will be offered throughout the conference week and weekend.  
These include:

- Guided architecture tours
- Field excursions to key sites
- A Junk Boat Party in Sai Kung

Tickets for these events will be **sold separately** and released at a later date.
